title: Perfect block slow motion: Arisen vs played Fighter pawn (watch only)
intro: BEFORE YOU PRESS END: open ground. The goblins in this test cannot die. Nothing is changed in the game; it only records what the perfect block does. Press End to start.

steps.text: GET READY (no timer): press End to spawn unkillable goblins.
steps.each_frame:
if not G_jg then
  G_jg = { stage = "-", by = {} }
  local function bump(k) local b = G_jg.by[G_jg.stage .. " | " .. k] or 0; G_jg.by[G_jg.stage .. " | " .. k] = b + 1 end
  local function goname(c) local n; pcall(function() n = c:call("get_GameObject"):call("get_Name") end); return n or "?" end
  local td = sdk.find_type_definition("app.JustGuardHitSlow")
  local m = td and td:get_method("start")
  if m then
    sdk.hook(m, function(args)
      thread.get_hook_storage().jg = args[2]
    end, function(r)
      local st = thread.get_hook_storage(); local p = st.jg; st.jg = nil
      pcall(function()
        local a = sdk.to_managed_object(p)
        local wr = a:get_field("CharaWorkRate")
        local who = wr and goname(wr) or "?"
        bump("JustGuardHitSlow " .. who .. (a:get_field("IsJustGuard") and " (perfect)" or " (not perfect)"))
      end)
      return r
    end)
  end
  local sa = sdk.find_type_definition("app.SlowAction")
  local m2 = sa and sa:get_method("start")
  if m2 then
    sdk.hook(m2, function(args) thread.get_hook_storage().sa = args[2] end, function(r)
      local st = thread.get_hook_storage(); local p = st.sa; st.sa = nil
      pcall(function()
        local a = sdk.to_managed_object(p)
        local ch = a:get_field("<CachedCharacter>k__BackingField")
        bump("SlowAction " .. (ch and goname(ch) or "?") .. (a:get_field("PlayerOnly") and " playeronly" or "") .. (a:get_field("EnableRequestSlow") and " ON" or " off"))
      end)
      return r
    end)
  end
  local wt = sdk.find_type_definition("app.WorkRate")
  local m3 = wt and wt:get_method("setHitStop(System.Single, System.Single, System.Boolean)")
  if m3 then sdk.hook(m3, function(args) bump("setHitStop") end, function(r) return r end) end
end
G_jg.stage = "-"
